item.description: [Bloomberg] Walt Disney reported sales and earnings that exceeded analysts’ expectations, with a particularly strong result in its streaming TV unit. Viewership of Marvel superhero-related programming more than doubled as fans caught up on the company’s catalog of Spider-Man and Avengers films, tied in part to theatrical releases from both this year, Disney said in a statement Tuesday.
